definitions.explanation: A formal document summarizing a company's or organization's financial position, including income, expenses, assets, and liabilities for a given period.

examples.japanese: {決算書|けっさんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧、{決算書|けっさんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}→作成：04186_sakusei⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Financial statements must be prepared every year.

examples.japanese: {決算書|けっさんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{経営状態|けいえいじょうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかる。
examples.english: By looking at the financial statements, you can understand the company's financial condition.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧ (settlement of accounts) and ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (document). An essential business and accounting term. In Japan, companies are required to prepare {決算書|けっさんしょ} at the end of each fiscal year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {決算書|けっさんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧ — to prepare financial statements
- {決算書|けっさんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ — to submit financial statements
- {決算書|けっさんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}する→分析する：25338_bunsekisuru⟧ — to analyze financial statements
- ⟦{連結|れんけつ}→連結：14388_renketsu⟧{決算書|けっさんしょ} — consolidated financial statements

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧ — settlement of accounts; the broader process of closing books for a period
- ⟦{貸借対照表|たいしゃくたいしょうひょう}→貸借対照表：24521_taishakutaishouhyou⟧ — balance sheet; one component of a full set of financial statements
